principles: Admiral can set every Fleet feature Off, Free or Paid for every vessel.
Owners may request eligible paid services but cannot self-grant or self-activate them.
Free capability status does not broaden vessel data scope.
Every service remains vessel-entitled and RLS-scoped.
Captain operationalizes only capabilities the Fleet has entitled for the vessel.
Capability passage is available across mission levels but never transfers vessel ownership, authority, branding, namespace, or project data.
Bootstrap Build is an independent Admiral-level program and is not a parent of operational vessels.
Public-source software is never treated as Fleet-owned merely because the Fleet adds an interface or hosting layer.
Foundry Scout may nominate upstream software, but clearance and Sea Trial remain deliberate human-governed gates.
Commercial packaging must preserve license obligations, upstream identity, required notices, privacy truth, and security boundaries.

objects.capability: versioned reusable Fleet feature; services may group capabilities without removing individual control
objects.entitlement: commercial and authority grant connecting one vessel to one capability
objects.request: owner expression of interest; never authority by itself
